A.title: Aligning to Adults Is Easy, Aligning to Children Is Hard: A Study of Linguistic Alignment in Dialogue Systems
A.venue: Proceedings of the 1st Human-Centered Large Language Modeling Workshop

paradigms.name: Linguistic alignment in dialogue (syntactic, lexical, and semantic alignment)
paradigms.source_paper: Garrod and Pickering (2004); Pickering and Ferreira (2008)

D.population: Adult North American English speakers in Switchboard; children aged 24–42 months and caretakers in CHILDES
D.metric: Cosine alignment scores for syntactic, lexical, and semantic features

E.headline: ChatGPT approximated adult alignment levels, while Llama 2 exceeded them; both systems aligned below human levels with children.

G.notes: The reported alignment scores are descriptive; no inferential model-human comparisons or uncertainty intervals are given. The authors note possible training-data overlap and that corpus-based evaluation may not capture dynamic adaptation to participants.
